_comment: Hand-checked AniList id -> Bangumi subject id. Wins over every automatic match.
Add an entry only after looking the subject up; bangumi-review.json is the queue to work from.
Most entries here exist because AniList and Bangumi disagree about where one show ends and
the next begins: AniList splits a cour-split run into two entries where Bangumi keeps one, so
both AniList ids point at the same subject. That is correct, not a collision.
A title Bangumi has not created yet (an unannounced season) does not belong here -- leave it
unmatched and the daily refresh will pick it up once the subject exists.

_notes.11741: Fate/Zero 2nd Season -> Fate/Zero. Bangumi keeps one 25-episode subject for both cours.
_notes.395: Gantz: Second Stage -> GANTZ ~the 2nd stage~. Exact, 2004-08-26, 13 eps both sides.
_notes.551: Grappler Baki Maximum Tournament -> グラップラー刃牙. Bangumi keeps the 48-episode run whole.
_notes.17115: Pokemon BW Adventures in Unova -> ベストウイッシュ シーズン2, which absorbs the Episode N arc.
_notes.97769: Yuki Yuna Hero Chapter -> the combined -鷲尾須美の章-/-勇者の章- subject.
_notes.209939: Frieren season 3 -> 葬送のフリーレン 第3期【黄金郷編】; the matcher misses it on the bracket suffix.
